T1.implementation_approach: Use a frontend framework like React or Vue.js to create a responsive and user-friendly interface for image upload. Include drag-and-drop functionality and a preview feature.
T1.notes: Ensure the UI is mobile-friendly and supports multiple file uploads.

T2.implementation_approach: Set up an API endpoint to handle image uploads. Use middleware to validate file types and sizes, and store the images in a cloud storage service or local server.
T2.notes: Implement security measures like file type validation and size limits.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a text input field using a frontend framework. Add features like character limits, placeholder text, and validation for input format.
T3.notes: Ensure accessibility and responsiveness for different devices.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up an API endpoint to receive text input. Validate the input on the server side and store it in a database.
T4.notes: Sanitize input to prevent security vulnerabilities like SQL injection.

T5.implementation_approach: Integrate a pre-trained AI model (e.g., GPT) using an API or SDK. Send user input to the model and return the generated content.
T5.notes: Optimize API calls to reduce latency and handle errors gracefully.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a visually appealing interface with suggestions tailored for a younger audience. Use vibrant colors, animations, and interactive elements.
T6.notes: Conduct user testing to ensure the design resonates with the target audience.

T7.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify the image upload functionality. Test for file type validation, size limits, and successful uploads.
T7.notes: Include edge cases like unsupported file types and large file sizes.

T8.implementation_approach: Write tests to validate the text input functionality. Check for character limits, input validation, and error handling.
T8.notes: Ensure the tests cover both frontend and backend validation.

T9.implementation_approach: Test the AI model integration by providing various inputs and verifying the generated content. Check for accuracy, relevance, and response time.
T9.notes: Include tests for edge cases and unexpected inputs.

T10.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a cloud platform. Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and monitoring.
T10.notes: Ensure the deployment process is scalable and secure.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a database schema to store user data, including images, text inputs, and metadata. Use a relational or NoSQL database based on requirements.
T11.notes: Optimize the schema for performance and scalability.

T12.implementation_approach: Connect the backend to the database using an ORM or database driver. Implement CRUD operations for user data.
T12.notes: Ensure proper error handling and data validation.
